title: A-linear representative and cohomology comparisons for global RHom
statement: Use the functors of [def-sfb-global-rhom-resolved-model]. For every E in D(R), every complex L and every isomorphism QL≅E, there is a family β_I:Q(representative(L,I))≅globalHom(E,QI) for all K-injective I, natural for all chain maps between them. Moreover there are additive equivalences H^q(globalHom(E,N))≃Hom(E,N[q]) for every N and q∈Z, natural for every derived morphism N→N′ and satisfying e(bx)=φ(b)e(x). This assertion does not mention towers or limits and adds no boundedness or flatness condition on L.

proof.text: Choose a K-flat resolution P of L. The existing natural internal-Hom sections comparison identifies internal RHom(E,QI) with Hom(P,I), which is K-injective. The derived-section unit is invertible there. Precomposition along P→L is a quasi-isomorphism because I is K-injective, so invert it and transport along QL≅E. Every chain map respects the section-ring action and its restriction along φ, giving β in D(A), natural on K-injective targets.

For N choose a K-injective representative I. Cohomology of the global Hom complex is homotopy classes L→I[q]. K-injectivity identifies them with derived morphisms E→N[q]. This is additive, natural by postcomposition, and A-linear because b acts by φ(b) on the target. The argument applies to all q∈Z.

theorem coefficient_model
    (E : DerivedCategory (Modules.{c, v, max c v r} R))
    (L : CochainComplex (Modules.{c, v, max c v r} R) ℤ)
    (eL : DerivedCategory.Q.obj L ≅ E) :
    ∃ β : ∀ (I : CochainComplex (Modules.{c, v, max c v r} R) ℤ) (_hI : I.IsKInjective),
        DerivedCategory.Q.obj ((representative.{c, v, r, a} R A φ L).obj I) ≅
          (globalHom.{c, v, r, a, w, z} R A φ E).obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj I),
      (∀ (I I' : CochainComplex (Modules.{c, v, max c v r} R) ℤ) (hI : I.IsKInjective)
        (hI' : I'.IsKInjective) (f : I ⟶ I'),
        DerivedCategory.Q.map ((representative.{c, v, r, a} R A φ L).map f) ≫ (β I' hI').hom =
          (β I hI).hom ≫ (globalHom.{c, v, r, a, w, z} R A φ E).map (DerivedCategory.Q.map f)) ∧
      ∃ e : ∀ (N : DerivedCategory (Modules.{c, v, max c v r} R)) (q : ℤ),
          ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{max c v r} A) q).obj
            ((globalHom.{c, v, r, a, w, z} R A φ E).obj N)) ≃+ (E ⟶ N⟦q⟧),
        (∀ (N N' : DerivedCategory (Modules.{c, v, max c v r} R)) (f : N ⟶ N') (q : ℤ)
          (x : (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{max c v r} A) q).obj
            ((globalHom.{c, v, r, a, w, z} R A φ E).obj N)),
          e N' q ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{max c v r} A) q).map
            ((globalHom.{c, v, r, a, w, z} R A φ E).map f) x) = e N q x ≫ f⟦q⟧') ∧
        (∀ (N : DerivedCategory (Modules.{c, v, max c v r} R)) (q : ℤ) (b : A)
          (x : (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{max c v r} A) q).obj
            ((globalHom.{c, v, r, a, w, z} R A φ E).obj N)),
          e N q (b • x) = (φ b) • e N q x)
